title: Per-row edit isolation untested: no test asserts row B's edit state stays unchanged while row A is typed
detail: Round-2 guard names per-row isolation, but rc-2 never holds edit state and is never asserted. A regression writing/prefilling other rows' entries on any keystroke passes both new tests.
recommended_fix: In the substitute test, seed rc-2 with its own RefcheckEdit entry and assert it (and rc-2's dict key set) is unchanged after typing into rc-1 and after the reordered refetch.

title: Save request payload asserted only indirectly — no test pins the fired correct/substitute body carries the typed values
detail: The #611 harm was save persisting the ORIGINAL contact. Tests stop at model state; lustre's simulate.event discards the effect (`let #(model, _) = simulation.update(...)`), so the outgoing payload is never inspected.
recommended_fix: Add a message-level test asserting the fired effect payload: call client.update with UserSavedRefcheckEdit and inspect via effect.map, or pin reference_checks_api.correct_reference args carry the typed values.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 100%: correct keystroke→dict→render→save, substitute keystroke, reorder-refetch survival, all three field branches — all pinned via real view+update. P1 100% (save dispatch correct/substitute covered by existing tests). Overall ≈90%.
recommended_fix: Close the two residual gaps: a two-row isolation assertion in the substitute test, and a direct payload pin on the save effect (typed vs original contact).
